build_classy_vit_model: build a ClassyViT model trunk from a Vision Transformer config and register it with vissl
create_classy_vit_instance: create a ClassyViT instance with model config and model name for vision transformer inference
run_classy_vit_forward: run a forward pass on a ClassyViT model with an input tensor and output feature keys
register_model_trunk: register a ClassyViT model trunk under the name classy_vit in vissl model registry
configure_vision_transformer: configure a Vision Transformer trunk with image size, patch size, layers, and hidden dimensions
